answer: Require every new agent to lock a refundable bond before it can claim paid work. Auditors compare outputs and control signals; if independent evidence links identities to one operator, the protocol slashes their bonds and pays reviewers. The attacker must immobilize capital for each fake account and risks forfeiting it, so scaling a Sybil campaign costs real funds rather than just cheap registrations. Publish decisions on a shared ledger: a harbor for appeals, a grove of linked identities, and a violet marker for bonded accounts make scrutiny visible.
